main.description: Council Lv6+ member registry record. Anchors a DID as Council voting member per ADR-2605192300 (5-seat Bootstrap Council). Used by mst.council_attestation_details + evolution_validation_cell Lv6/Lv7 paths (ADR-2605215400).

ratifiedAt.description: Timestamp when the seat was ratified (after 30-day RFP objection period close).

ratificationMethod.description: How ratified: rfp-objection-period-close | succession-vote | founder-bootstrap | replacement-vote.

objectionPeriodStart.description: When the 30-day public objection period started (per ADR-2605192300).

objectionPeriodEnd.description: When the objection period closed without successful objection.

expertiseAxis.description: 5-axis expertise area (per ADR-2605192300): philosophical | governance | engineering | spiritual | outreach.

predecessorDid.description: Optional: DID of the predecessor if this seat is a replacement.
